scope: Default source-checkout RPC discovery and token-ranking implementation; pinned protocol source and license observations
boundary: Engineering source evidence only. This packet does not establish legal clearance, CE certification, product classification, support obligations, compliance, complete coverage, or publication authority.

discovery.factScope: Verified chain, factory/program, pool/mint, token-pair, account, block, and context facts from configured public RPC responses.
discovery.admissionBoundary: New token proposals remain unclassified with address-only names and symbols and null stableCurrency, underlyingAssetId, and economicReferenceAssetId until review. Admission is bounded at 8 tokens and 8 pools per run; deferred candidates require fresh verified revalidation.

ranking.metricDefinition: Total supply multiplied by the direct native-pool price, represented as reduced exact rational native atomic units; explicitly not circulating market capitalization.
ranking.coverageBoundary: Partial coverage and unranked reasons remain explicit. Native units and unavailable, stale, invalid, unpriced, below-floor, or rights-denied observations are not silently converted to ranked zeroes.

defaultInputs.rpcFacts: Configured public RPC facts from the local discovery and ranking configurations.
defaultInputs.arithmetic: Independent implementation in the repository; no protocol SDK, implementation source, or vendor market-cap dataset is imported or redistributed.
defaultInputs.offlineLookups: Bundled catalog and ranking list APIs read local generated data only and do not call an external vendor API, RPC endpoint, or current clock.
defaultInputs.sdkDistribution: Registry evidence and raw RPC receipts are omitted from SDK distributions.

primarySources.factualFieldsOrLayoutRole: Historical Whirlpool account layout facts for liquidity, sqrt price, token mints, token vaults, reward fields, account length, and PDA seed context.
primarySources.reuseStatus: No Orca code, current SDK, package, logo, or implementation text is copied or used as a dependency; layout facts are independently represented.
primarySources.licenseObservation: The pinned historical LICENSE header states Apache License 2.0. The current LICENSE states Apache coverage through February 26, 2025 and an Orca License beginning February 27, 2025, with restrictive use terms and no trademark or logo grant.

primarySources.factualFieldsOrLayoutRole: Pinned PoolState layout and pool PDA seed facts used to identify CLMM account ownership, mints, vaults, liquidity, and related account roles.
primarySources.reuseStatus: No Raydium source implementation, SDK, package, or logo is copied or used as a dependency; layout and address facts only.
primarySources.licenseObservation: The pinned repository LICENSE begins with the Apache License, Version 2.0 notice.
